List: scene as is, name, action and status names only from the admin dictionary (codes when missing), threshold keys as links to /config?item=<key> (no threshold input on this page), update time in Beijing time; states and 10403. Enable / disable: confirmation with optional reason, a fresh totp step-up every time, expected_version from the row, the returned row replaces it, already-in-target-state succeeds, 20902 and 20001 [rule_id] refresh, an unknown outcome is never resent (the list is read again). No finalized design spec; boards only as layout reference.
